supersedes.relationship: carries the v1 GNN topology-family assignment forward BY REFERENCE (v1 is never edited); v2 adds the FORECASTING dataset registration discipline (P15.18). A v1 content dispute is a NEW manifest version, never an edit of either file.

status: NO DATASET EXISTS: every per-instance row is EMPTY and is filled only by the human/lab generation gate (the P8.35 discipline carried unchanged). The forecasting dataset families below are REGISTERED STRUCTURES with EMPTY rows - no forecast dataset was generated, no evaluation was run, and every result cell belongs to the P15.05 framework and is EMPTY.

v1_carry_forward.description: The v1 GNN topology-family assignment (families, tracks, findings F-1/F-2, the instance-ID scheme, the leakage controls, the license and poisoning registers) is carried forward BY REFERENCE - read v1 for it; nothing in v2 re-decides or restates it. v2 touches ONLY the dataset-registration surface below.

dataset_registration_discipline.description: The registration fields EVERY dataset (GNN or forecasting) carries at generation time, extending the P8.35 per-dataset provenance record standard to forecasting datasets (P15.18). A field that cannot be filled is recorded 'unavailable: <reason>' at generation time, never omitted and never guessed (the P3.27 discipline, mirrored).
required_fields: source (simulator-generated or labeled synthetic ONLY in 0.x; generation_method + generator version recorded per instance)
size (instance count; a filled cell at generation time)
leakage_controls (the REQUIRED declarations, checked at evaluation time)
digest_rule (digests pinned BEFORE training; a content change is a NEW dataset_version, never a silent edit)
dataset_registration_discipline.versioning_rule: a dataset content change is a NEW dataset_version; a family-assignment or registration-discipline change is a NEW manifest version; never a silent edit (the P8.19 anti-silent-growth rule). Eval-set growth follows the same rule: forecast-eval-set-v2 is a NEW FILE, never an edit of forecast-eval-set-v1 (the P15.05 frozen-artifact rule).

no_production_data_in_simulation.rule: NO production data enters simulation or any training/evaluation dataset (the Phase 8/9 discipline carried): the 0.x platform has never run, no production data exists, and the ONLY permitted dataset sources are (a) simulator-generated series over the declared scenario library and (b) the labeled SYNTHETIC fixture (P3.31, provenance 'synthetic'). A dataset row whose source is not one of these two is INVALID and must not be entered (fail-closed).

registered_families.structural_definition: the backtesting windows over the P3.31 labeled synthetic fixture (the ONLY eval source that exists); registered by the frozen artifact benchmarks/forecast-eval-set-v1.json (forecast-eval-set-v1), which owns the windows, metrics, thresholds, and the EMPTY result cells
registered_families.source: the P3.31 synthetic fixture (provenance 'synthetic'; generated deterministically from the scenario-v2 declaration)
registered_families.instance_count: EMPTY - owned by the frozen eval-set artifact (run_status NOT_RUN in every cell)
registered_families.growth_rule: eval-set growth is forecast-eval-set-v2 as a NEW FILE with a NEW registered-window/threshold set (X-8: thresholds are registered BEFORE any run that could fill them); the v1 artifact is never edited
registered_families.row_note: EMPTY - one row per generated window at the human/lab generation gate: {window_id, train_span, test_span, generator_version, seed, generated_utc, source_record_digest}.

registered_families.structural_definition: simulator-generated load/PV series over the scenario library, for FUTURE baseline/ML forecast training - REGISTERED STRUCTURE ONLY: no training run exists, every model registers UNTRAINED (P15.06 first-class state), and no training may occur before the human generation gate resolves the framework DECISION-POINTs (the P8.35 gate procedure)
registered_families.source: apps/sim-runner generation over the declared family parameter sets (generator version recorded per instance)
registered_families.row_note: EMPTY - one row per generated instance at the human/lab generation gate: {instance_id, family_id, generator_version, parameter_set_ref, seed, generated_utc, source_record_digest}. A dataset version whose rows are incomplete is not freezable.

fail_closed_scope_checks.description: The P8.11 fail-closed scope-check discipline EXTENDED to forecasting datasets (P15.18): a consumer of a forecasting dataset must verify the dataset against its REGISTERED scope before use, and anything not EXACTLY inside the registered scope flags out-of-scope (outputs refused/NULL, never fuzzy-passed).
rules: EXACT string equality on dataset ids and instance ids (the P8.11 evaluate_topology_scope discipline mirrored; no fuzzy or prefix matching - a near-miss flags, never passes)

a forecasting worker request naming a dataset whose id is not EXACTLY registered here (or in the frozen eval-set artifact) is REFUSED with a named error - there is no default dataset and no degraded-mode forecast
a dataset row whose source is neither simulator-generated nor the labeled synthetic fixture is INVALID and flags (the no-production-data rule above, enforced at registration AND at consumption)
the scope check runs on the CONSUMER side at evaluation/training time; the reviewer re-checks (the P8.10 verification-method discipline mirrored)

current_registered_scope.current_state: EMPTY BY DESIGN: the forecast_training scope list is EMPTY (no training dataset exists); any request naming a forecast_training dataset flags out-of-scope (fail-closed by design) until instances are generated and recorded here

forecasting_datasets.license_register_ref: ledger/phase-08-advanced-coordination/35_training_data_provenance.md section 5 (forecasting datasets inherit the P8.03/P8.35 discipline unchanged; ANDES GPLv3 isolation applies to training-data outputs; the torch/PyG DECISION-POINTs are carried OPEN)
forecasting_datasets.poisoning_controls_ref: ledger/phase-08-advanced-coordination/35_training_data_provenance.md section 6 (ingestion schema/range/duplication checks, quarantine WITH a record, digests pinned before training; the poisoning-detection run is a HUMAN GATE, UNRUN - carried unchanged for forecasting datasets)
forecasting_datasets.adr_010_note: No dataset, eval result, or trained model authorizes or produces a dispatch command (ADR-010 extension, program conventions 6.3): datasets feed forecasts, forecasts are INPUTS; the never-granted permission set (dispatch.authorize, dispatch.issue, secret.read, network.any) is untouched by this manifest.
